cds.title: Utah State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-time first-year students): 21,235 applied, 19,562 admitted (92.1%), 4,594 enrolled (institution-wide Common Data Set). Utah State did not fill in the residency table (in-state / out-of-state / international), so no international applicant or admit counts are available; the Common Data Set's enrollment table by race/ethnicity shows 22 nonresident first-year students enrolled. The GPA breakdown is copied exactly as printed (the 2.0-2.49 band shows 8.5%, which looks high next to a 3.6 average, but it is the published figure). Undergraduate enrollment is 26,629 ('Total Undergraduates', including part-time and non-degree; 20,236 degree-seeking); 218 nonresidents is the total column (107 degree-seeking). No early decision/action; no waitlist; student-to-faculty ratio 20:1. The admission factors list GPA and test scores as very important even though the test policy marks SAT/ACT as not required but considered.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'; scores are also used for advising and placement.

cost.notes: First-year costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set: in-state tuition $8,272, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $25,717, required fees $793, on-campus food and housing $9,746, books $856, transportation $2,648, other $1,628. Tuition varies by program
